evidence.title: WARP: Wasserstein-Aligned RAG for Population Opinions

summary: A new study presents WARP, a Wasserstein-Aligned Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) model designed to better align AI outputs with diverse population opinions. The approach aims to improve fairness and representativeness in AI-generated responses.
title: Researchers Introduce WARP: A New RAG Framework for Aligning AI with Population Opinions
